title: External API engine with adaptive concurrency
objective: Generic provider model: pooled HTTP/2 clients, per-provider rate (rps, tokens/min) and concurrency budgets, retries with backoff+jitter, circuit breaker, timeouts, priority, idempotency, adaptive concurrency reacting to 429/5xx/latency; local fake upstream.
acceptance_criteria: Unit + property tests for limiter, breaker, AIMD controller
Against the fake upstream: engine backs off on 429 storms and recovers; useful-throughput benchmark recorded
